report.answer: If this tree were published as-is, estate-identifying Windows home paths would leave with it (content count 44996; independent byte-prefix count 43970). Credential-shaped filenames counted 12; transcript/session files 62; event-ledger files 134. Unix home paths after colon-exclusion counted 1688. No discovered secret or personal value is reproduced in this record, only location and category. Naive per-line redaction is not effective. The minimum contract that survived constructed bypasses is: M1b_decode_then_redact, M2b_path_and_content, M3b_filename_and_shape, M4_location_only_reports, M5_packed_bytes_gate. The current tree does not pass the packed-bytes gate; the gate is the publication precondition, not a claim that the tree is already clean. SUCCESS:RES-0124 in the receipt AND a category-count scan over the real tree with a passing seeded-identifier detector control
